# Surrey Street Partners

> Surrey Street Partners is a hands-on consulting firm that builds production technology for companies in commerce, payments, and AI. We embed with engineering teams to ship working software — not decks or recommendations.

## What we do

Surrey Street Partners specializes in:

- **Payments infrastructure**: Authorization optimization, processor integrations, vault architecture, fallback routing, payment method strategy
- **AI systems**: Production agentic workflows, LLM-powered products, intelligent automation, conversational AI platforms
- **Communications platforms**: CPaaS architecture on Twilio and RCS, SMS, in-app messaging, multi-channel notification infrastructure
- **B2B monetization**: Pricing strategy, usage-based billing, packaging design, revenue architecture for technical platforms

## How we work

1. **Discover** — Understand your business, your stack, and the constraint that matters most. No prepackaged methodology.
2. **Architect** — Design systems that work in production. Every architecture decision maps to a business outcome.
3. **Build** — Write code, ship prototypes, and stand up infrastructure. Embedded with your team, working in your repos, on your timelines.
4. **Validate** — Every deliverable is tested against real users and real data. We don't hand off until it works — and you can prove it works.

## Team

- **Vevina McAllister** — Founder & Principal. Former payments and commerce leader. Built production AI systems, CPaaS platforms, and B2B pricing strategies across fintech, e-commerce, and SaaS. [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/vmmcallister/)

## Engagement model

Surrey Street Partners takes on a small number of engagements at a time. We are best suited for companies working on hard problems in commerce, payments, or AI that need senior, embedded operators — not advisors.
